# Locked PyPI deps for backlog-burn's post-disable-sudo preflight pip step
# (issue #870 / Cipher). Exact versions + sha256 hashes for every direct and
# transitive package. Install with:
#   python3 -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps \
#     -r .github/backlog-burn-preflight-requirements.txt
# Then install the first-party tools without resolving more PyPI deps:
#   python3 -m pip install --no-deps -e tools/printcheck
#   python3 -m pip install --no-deps -e tools/stylelift
#
# Regenerate (Python 3.12, matching actions/setup-python in backlog-burn.yml):
#   pip-compile --allow-unsafe --generate-hashes \
#     --output-file=.github/backlog-burn-preflight-requirements.txt \
#     .github/backlog-burn-preflight-requirements.in
#
